# Contributing to AutoPartsPro\n\n## Project Structure\n\n### Frontend (Next.js)\n```\n./src/                  # Next.js frontend source\n├── app/                # App Router pages\n├── components/         # Reusable React components\n├── hooks/              # Custom hooks (Zustand stores)\n├── lib/                # Utilities and data\n└── types/              # TypeScript types\n```\n\n### Backend (FastAPI)\n```\n./backend/              # FastAPI backend source\n├── app/\n│   ├── models/         # SQLAlchemy database models\n│   ├── schemas/        # Pydantic validation schemas\n│   ├── routes/         # API endpoint handlers\n│   ├── utils/          # Utilities (security, helpers)\n│   ├── config.py       # Settings and configuration\n│   └── database.py     # Database connection\n├── main.py             # FastAPI app entry point\n├── requirements.txt    # Python dependencies\n└── docker-compose.yml  # Local dev with PostgreSQL\n```\n\n## Branches\n\n- **main** — Production-ready code (frontend + backend)\n- Feature branches: `feature/feature-name`, `fix/bug-name`\n\n## Pull Requests\n\nThis repo uses PRs to organize work:\n- Each major feature gets a branch and PR\n- PRs describe what changed and why\n- Merge to main only when ready\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Frontend\n```bash\ncd .  # Root directory\nnpm install\nnpm run dev  # http://localhost:3000\n```\n\n### Backend\n```bash\ncd backend\ndocker-compose up -d  # Start PostgreSQL + FastAPI\n# API docs at http://localhost:8000/docs\n```\n"
